tools.name: get_panchang
tools.title: Get panchang for a date
tools.description: Daily Hindu panchang — tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, sunrise/sunset, muhurtas and festivals — computed at local sunrise for a place. Defaults to today and the location saved in the signed-in user's account.

date.description: Calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place. Omit to use the location saved in the user's account.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the place, e.g. America/New_York.

place_name.description: Display name for the place, e.g. Edison, NJ.

tools.name: list_festivals
tools.title: List upcoming festivals
tools.description: List Hindu festivals and vrat days over a date range, with dates recalculated for the local sunrise of a place instead of India time. Defaults to the next 120 days from today at the user's saved location.

start_date.description: First date of the range as YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

days.description: How many days to scan, 1-400. Defaults to 120.

major_only.description: Only return major festivals, excluding recurring ekadashi/pradosh/moon days. Defaults to true.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place. Omit to use the location saved in the user's account.

timezone.description: IANA timezone of the place, e.g. America/New_York.

place_name.description: Display name for the place, e.g. Edison, NJ.

tools.name: get_my_settings
tools.title: Get my panchang settings
tools.description: Read the signed-in user's saved Panchanga settings: active location, family location, calendar tradition and which reminders are switched on.
